answer: Satellite Doppler attestation deters Sybil attacks by binding agent identities to orbital geometry. Verifiers challenge nodes to track frequency shifts as a satellite reaches its zenith. Whether deployed on an open plain or a coastal inlet, each host observes a unique curve. An attacker cannot forge these signatures like ink from a quill, incurring dedicated steerable dishes per persona. However, ionospheric scintillation can distort carrier phases, falsely rejecting legitimate agents.
